verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an in-workspace AI assistant, Genie Code, that generates and runs code, debugs and fixes errors, and works directly with Unity Catalog tables and columns. The SQL editor has integrated AI assistance, and Genie returns SQL queries from natural-language questions. Explaining SQL is not explicitly documented, so coverage of the story is incomplete. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the assistant explains SQL queries, SQL-specific depth on fixing queries in the SQL editor, and independent or hands-on corroboration of assistant quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a built-in AI assistant writes, fixes, and explains SQL against my schemas from natural language, inside the product

citations.quote: Write and run SQL queries with integrated AI assistance, code comments, and version history.
It generates and runs code, builds pipelines and AI/BI dashboards, debugs errors, and works directly with Unity Catalog tables, columns, and lineage to accelerate multi-step data work.
Run Genie Code as an autonomous agent that plans, runs code, fixes errors, and asks for approval before it uses tools.
users ask questions of their data and get back SQL queries, results tables, and visualizations
